interface.shortDescription: Full-stack agent framework — dev, growth, debate, and PM in one plugin
interface.longDescription: ForgeBee is a batteries-included development and growth framework for coding agents. It ships 37 slash commands, 44 specialist agents, 33 skills (inline + context:fork), 25 lifecycle hooks, adversarial debate pipelines, continuous learning, a 9-phase Growth OS marketing pipeline, and automated project management dashboards. Use /workflow for full pipeline orchestration, /team for ad-hoc multi-agent delegation, and /review-all as a pre-push quality gate.
